question: Can a narrowly legal NDJSON representation change be generated, independently audited and observed on two exact checker profiles without treating checker agreement as semantic authority?

primary_sources.title: Lean 4 export format 3.1.0
primary_sources.relevance: Defines separate Name, Level and Expr back references and groups declarations; it does not itself authorize arbitrary reorderings.

primary_sources.title: Nanoda parser
primary_sources.relevance: Requires continuous indices and rejects duplicate interned Name, Level and Expr nodes, while resolving typed references during parsing.

primary_sources.title: Metamorphic Testing: A New Approach for Generating Next Test Cases
primary_sources.relevance: Supplies the source/follow-up-test and domain-specific-relation method; it does not prove this representation relation.

primary_sources.title: Compiler Validation via Equivalence Modulo Inputs
primary_sources.relevance: Supports scoped same-implementation comparison of justified variants, while its input-relative program equivalence is not reused as an NDJSON oracle.

primary_sources.title: An Automatic Testing Approach for Compiler Based on Metamorphic Testing Technique
primary_sources.relevance: Demonstrates compiler testing with equivalence-preserving source transformations; no transformation from that work is imported here.

reuse: Exact retained official and Nanoda binaries and their profile definitions
Two small controls with raw prior ACCEPT receipts on both exact binaries
Existing process-accounting, fail-closed evidence and raw-diagnostic conventions
build: A separately implemented canonical graph auditor
excluded: Whitespace or JSON key-order changes as substantive variants
reuse_assessment.duplicate_search: No local NDJSON topological-renumbering transformer or independent canonical graph auditor was found.

legal_relation.name: typed dependency-respecting primitive reorder with contiguous renumbering
legal_relation.domain: Format-3.1.0 files with exactly one metadata record, one declaration-free primitive prefix, then a fixed declaration sequence; the two selected files each contain one final definition.
legal_relation.justification: A schedule changes only the order and contiguous identifiers of primitive Name, Level and Expr nodes. Every typed reference is rewritten through the corresponding complete bijection. Metadata, declaration order, declaration fields, graph constructors, sharing, dependencies and all non-reference values remain fixed. An independent decoder compares the resulting typed graph and canonical declarations while failing closed.
legal_relation.limits: This is a mechanically checked structural relation for two exact inputs and tooling revisions, not a theorem about arbitrary exports or semantic equivalence.

profiles.supported_fragment: Format 3.1.0 controls accepted under Lean v4.33.0 replay
Format >=3.1.0 and <3.2.0 under the bound four-thread permissive-axiom configuration

original_selection_rule: Select every exact retained augmented-comparison control, ordered by control path, for which the current bound official and Nanoda binary hashes both have raw ACCEPT receipts, record count is at most 32, bytes are at most 4096, the file has metadata then one primitive prefix then one ordinary declaration, and the pair adds a distinct expression or universe feature; cap at two. This yields the let control then the imax control, with no replacements after freeze.
independent_preservation_design: The auditor is a separate module that does not import the transformer. It decodes strict known schemas, resolves typed references, rejects unknown/missing/extra/duplicate/unresolved nodes, constructs collision-resistant canonical typed-node identities while retaining sharing, and compares metadata plus the ordered canonical declaration vector. Changed-object and malformed controls must fail.
named_useful_output: A reusable bounded transformer/auditor/runner package and four exact original/variant pairs with a complete twelve-cell observation matrix; any contribution recommendation remains conditional on demonstrated maintenance value and duplicate review.

reasons: At least one narrow legal relation is justified and independently checkable.
Two exact independent checker profiles are locally available and previously accepted both selected controls.
The finite selection rule yields exactly two originals without adaptive replacement.
The preservation design fails closed and is separate from transformation code.
The intended executable package and matrix are concrete shared outputs.
